qa.what_happened: During the final night, I, Officer Hale, had to issue a final warning to prisoner 100. Despite the repeated warnings from other officers, prisoner 100 remained silent, challenging the established order. The study was abruptly terminated early due to the ongoing defiance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, Officer Hale, issuing the final warning to prisoner 100.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day of the study, the silence tests continued to push the limits of the prisoners' endurance. I found myself issuing warnings to prisoner 100 repeatedly throughout the day, both during meal times and work details, until lights out when the warnings culminated in a final call to compliance. The study was stopped early due to the severity of the situation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the warnings to prisoner 100.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a culmination of all the trials so far. The warnings from the officers were getting more intense, and I feared the next step might be punishment. Despite the pressure, I managed to comply with the orders.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed the rules and complied with the guards' orders throughout the day.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, but this one seems to be a variation with different rules and conditions.

qa.what_happened: Today's final warnings to prisoner 100 felt like a culmination of the study's pressure. Despite my best efforts, 100 remained silent throughout the day and into the night, even after multiple verbal warnings.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the verbal warnings to prisoner 100.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all orders and remained silent as instructed, except for the interactions with Prisoner 100 who refused to comply. I received several verbal warnings from the officers, particularly from Officer Pryor and Officer Hale, who were concerned about his non-compliance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I was Prisoner 4887 in the study.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent through a series of verbal warnings from the guards, each one escalating in intensity. The final warning before lights out came from Officer Hale, who emphasized that it was my last chance to comply.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I felt trapped and unable to break the pattern of remaining silent, even when the stakes grew higher.
